run_training: run the AVT video action anticipation training pipeline using Hydra config and PyTorch distributed training
train_one_epoch: train one epoch of the AVT model with gradient clipping, logging, and checkpoint saving
evaluate_model: evaluate the trained AVT model on validation or test datasets and store accuracy results
store_checkpoint: store a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer state, learning rate scheduler, and epoch number
setup_training: perform initial setup for distributed training including DDP wrapping, optimizer creation, and learning rate scheduling
